agents.title: With coding agents
agents.body: Agents write most first drafts. I set the plan, the data model and the rules, and I answer for what runs. They work in parallel git worktrees and have opened 64 of the 85 pull requests so far. A written contract comes first, then a local gate of lint, typecheck and tests, then my merge. What is missing: a CI server and a second reviewer.

production.title: On my own machine
production.body: I am moving everything I run from Vercel onto one machine at home: 21 Docker Compose services behind a Cloudflare Tunnel, with no inbound ports. A new version starts only if its migration succeeds; otherwise the old one keeps running. One TypeScript spec generates the 53 uptime monitors.
